deviations: After apm install the journey restores the tracked .gitignore (git checkout -- .gitignore) and lists apm.yml, apm.lock.yaml and apm_modules/ in .git/info/exclude (once). Reason: APM 0.24.0 always writes apm.yml and apm.lock.yaml at the consumer root and appends apm_modules/ to the tracked .gitignore (docs/findings.md); the owner rule is that nothing edits the main checkout except landing, so its status must stay empty.
